### 2026-10-19 – I started by learning all about a theremin. This involved reading Wikipedia pages and talking with an LLM when I didnt understand something. I then went online and searched for a schematic for a there

**1.5h**

I started by learning all about a theremin. This involved reading Wikipedia pages and talking with an LLM when I didnt understand something. I then went online and searched for a schematic for a theremin that had both volume and pitch control. I settled on Silicon Chip August 2000 theremin. Here is the schematic for anyone interested.

### 2026-10-25 – I worked on the case for the theremin. It involved making an enclosure and deciding where to put the speaker and jack and where to store the antenna and aluminum plate when it is not in use. I made us

**3h**

I worked on the case for the theremin. It involved making an enclosure and deciding where to put the speaker and jack and where to store the antenna and aluminum plate when it is not in use. I made use of mounting holes in the PCB for the first time too.
